data.name: Nushrratt
data.gender_notes: Nushrratt is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of power and good governance
data.long_meaning: Nushrratt is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nushasan' (good governance) and 'rat' (ruler). This name represents a powerful leader, a just ruler, and a protector. It is believed to bring prosperity and strength to the one who bears this name. The name Nushrratt carries the meaning “God of power and good governance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nushrratt usually hope their child will grow to embody god of power and good governance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine authority and the power to rule with wisdom and compassion.
data.etymology: Nushrratt belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of power and good governance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nushrratt total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Nushrratt is a name of royal descent, suggestive of a strong leadership and wise rule. In Hindu cultural tradition, names hold immense significance and often encapsulate the essence of a person's identity, purpose, and destiny. Being named Nushrratt implies that one carries the weight of good governance and just rule, symbolizing a leader worthy of veneration and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nushrratt also holds significant spiritual resonance. It alludes to Dharma, the ethical principles and duties that guide an individual's actions and ultimately leads to spiritual growth and evolution. As a Nushrratt, one is expected to uphold the virtues of virtuous governance through fairness, impartiality, and compassion. It is a name that instills a sense of responsibility towards one's community and a duty to protect and serve the greater good.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nushrratt, meaning 'one who has attained the supreme consciousness,' embodies the spiritual journey towards self-realization and enlightenment in Hindu tradition. This name symbolizes the pursuit of inner peace and wisdom, transcending the mundane world and connecting with the divine.

historical_references.reference: Nushrratt Maharaj was a famous Jain Tirthankara who lived during the 22nd Jain Tirthankara cycle, around 1000 BCE. He is known for his contributions to Jain philosophy, particularly his teachings on non-violence and asceticism.

Nushrratt is also mentioned in Hindu mythology as a king of Haihayas, a legendary dynasty of northwestern India. He is said to have ruled around 1000 BCE and was known for his strong moral character and generosity towards his subjects.
